title.narrative: Improving food security and resilience of food production systems in Karamoja

description.narrative: The project `Improving food security and resilience of food production systems in Karamoja¿ aims at enhanced resilience and gender-responsiveness of food production and livelihood systems for food and nutrition security in Karamoja sub-region. It is designed under four outcome areas: i) Food systems are more inclusive and economically sustainable, ii) Enhanced environmental sustainability of food systems, iii) Enhanced social sustainability of food systems, and iv) Governments lead and proactively respond to food crises. It applies the framework of Building, Protecting, Stabilizing and Enabling, where the elements link to different dimensions of sustainability.
